# UDAAN 2026 — Bhagalpur College of Engineering (BCE)

> UDAAN 2026 is the annual sports fest of Bhagalpur College of Engineering (BCE), Bhagalpur, Bihar, organized by UDAAN Sports Club.

- **Event:** UDAAN 2026 (Annual Sports & Esports Fest)
- **Dates:** 27–30 November 2026
- **Venue:** Bhagalpur College of Engineering, Bhagalpur, Bihar, India
- **Official Website:** https://roxx-udaan-bce.pages.dev/
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/udaan_bce/
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61552059662887

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://roxx-udaan-bce.pages.dev/): Event overview, sports lineup, about BCE & UDAAN Sports Club, and contacts.
- [Registration](https://roxx-udaan-bce.pages.dev/Templates/registration): Online registration for team and solo sports events.
- [IGNITION Esports](https://roxx-udaan-bce.pages.dev/Templates/ignition): Official esports championship (BGMI, Free Fire, Valorant, eFootball).
- [Torchbearers](https://roxx-udaan-bce.pages.dev/Templates/torchbearers): Presidents & Vice Presidents of UDAAN Sports Club (2026: Akash Deep; 2025: Avineesh Kumar, Anmol Ratan).
- [Gallery](https://roxx-udaan-bce.pages.dev/Templates/gallery): Photo highlights from UDAAN sports and campus events.
- [Principal's Message](https://roxx-udaan-bce.pages.dev/Templates/director): Welcome message from the Principal of BCE Bhagalpur.
- [Archive](https://roxx-udaan-bce.pages.dev/Templates/archive): Past editions and memories of UDAAN.
- [Developers](https://roxx-udaan-bce.pages.dev/Templates/developers): Student engineering team behind the UDAAN 2026 web platform.
